reason: A web UI theme plugin that discovers theme packs, applies their tokens and optional CSS/assets, and lets users switch among them without changing layout or executing pack JavaScript.

summaries.zh: 用于发现、加载和切换网页客户端主题包的插件，可应用颜色令牌、CSS及静态字体和图片资源。
summaries.en: A plugin for discovering, loading, and switching web client theme packs with color tokens, CSS, and static font and image assets.

capabilities: Applies CSS custom properties and optional CSS to the web client
Loads pack-relative fonts, images, previews, and other static assets
Watches configured theme-pack directories and serves catalog and pack files
Stores the selected theme-pack identifier in plugin settings
